newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares inch higher on light buying.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares inch higher on light buying.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed slightly higher in slow trading on Tuesday on light buying after steady declines over the past few sessions, brokers said.
The B share index gained 0.18 points, or 0.20 percent, to 88.98 on turnover of HK$14.64 million, compared with HK$15.50 million on Monday.

Despite the rise, market sentiment remained fragile, with little follow-up demand and signs that investors are becoming increasingly pessimistic about the future of the market, which has seen bearish trading for a long time, brokers said.
They said Tuesday's gain was linked to China Marine, which surged HK$0.60, or 10.17 percent, to HK$6.50 on thin trade of 8,600 shares due to speculative purchasing.
Nanshan Power Station, which dropped sharply on light speculative selling on Monday, rebounded HK$0.10, or five percent, to HK$2.10, with 17,900 shares traded.
Little Swan advanced HK$0.20 to HK$5.40 as 380,000 shares changed hands. The rise was due to investor confidence in the washing machine maker's earnings outlook, analysts said.
Tellus, the worst performer, dived HK$0.26, or 14.94 percent, to HK$1.48 on a single trade of 200 shares.

Guangdong Power followed, sliding HK$0.20 to HK$4.80 on volume of 380,500 shares on institutional selling, analysts said. Newcomer Changan fell back HK$0.03 to HK$1.74 on the day's heaviest volume of 1.34 million shares.
The A market reversed slight early losses and ended higher on institutional buying due to bullish sentiment, brokers said.

The A share index climbed 6.91 points, or 1.75 percent, to its intraday high, also a record high, of 401.57, on turnover of 11.40 billion yuan, compared with 11.39 billion on Monday. The composite index firmed 6.23 points, or 1.70 percent, to 373.09.
Shenyang Alloy Co Ltd, which listed 14 million A shares in Shenzhen on Tuesday, ended the session at 13.85 yuan, compared with an offer price of one yuan per share in 1990.
Fertiliser producer Hubei Zhongtian Co Ltd, which floated 11.122 million A shares and 1.878 million staff shares in Shenzhen on Tuesday, closed the day at 24.80 yuan.
The A shares were issued at 9.30 yuan per share via the Shenzhen exchange's automated quotation system last month and the staff shares were offered at one yuan per share in 1993.
Shenzhen Tellus, the third biggest gainer, soared 0.78 yuan, or 10.99 percent, to 7.88 yuan.
